scope: Local Double Diamond research tool with a first single-operator browser interface and Python APIs: evidence-backed Discover/Define/Develop/Deliver, bounded iteration and explicit human decisions. No built-in independent identity/source provider or external execution.
completion_rule: All eight required criteria must be satisfied; fixture checks alone cannot satisfy the host-checked acceptance case. Full regression and packaged-source verification must also pass.

criteria.title: Reviewed evidence intake
criteria.acceptance: Controller candidate is saved, explicitly reviewed and atomically ingested; source passages and synthetic labels remain traceable.

criteria.title: Durable analysis
criteria.acceptance: Claims, evidence assessments, contradictions, uncertainty and disposition changes persist through authenticated revision-checked transactions, restart and checkpoint restore.

criteria.title: Durable human decisions
criteria.acceptance: Gate proposals and authenticated approve/reject decisions are durable, audited and scoped to the intended action; pending or wrong-type gates block progression.

criteria.title: Double Diamond research workflow with bounded iteration
criteria.acceptance: Run Discover, Define, Develop and Deliver as explicit research phases; preserve earlier findings when revisiting phases, gate reframing, and record selected-alternative evaluations with recommend/revise/stop outcomes.

criteria.title: Traceable research report
criteria.acceptance: A readable report distinguishes evidence, interpretations, hypotheses, uncertainty and synthetic examples, with claim-to-source passages/locations and approval/publication status.

criteria.title: Recovery and backup
criteria.acceptance: Saved handoff, approved evidence and checkpoint data reopen without duplicate ingestion; unapproved gates remain blocked.

criteria.title: Runnable local fixture
criteria.acceptance: A self-contained offline demo can be run from a clean package, labels all material synthetic, and does not claim a finished research result or real reviewer authentication.

criteria.title: Host-checked acceptance case
criteria.acceptance: After full integration, run a bounded case with independently acquired real-source snapshots and an authenticated human review; record limitations and user/host acceptance without replacing this with fixture approval.

work_plan.title: Acceptance case and release package
work_plan.deliverable: Full end-to-end fixture plus host-checked bounded source case, reproducible guide, regression/package verification and explicit remaining limitations.

estimate: Cycle 145 adds bounded advisory draft interpretation revisions with preserved history and stale-context review. Actual research and host acceptance remain pending. Completion timing is not guaranteed.
change_rule: Do not expand this MVP for optional enhancements. Add work only for a required acceptance criterion, a defect blocking it, or an explicit user scope change.

completed_cycles.deliverable: Typed advisory analysis transactions, locally anchored replay journal, compatibility migration and checkpoint verification.
Durable host-authorized proposals and approve/reject decisions, exact action/version binding and atomic local consumption.
Bounded durable brief-to-synthesis workflow, action-bound human transitions, stop/escalate and source-traceable draft report exports.
Report-bound host acceptance API, real-source snapshot attestations, explicit fixture separation and public-source review packet. MVP-08 remains pending.
Explicit research phases, immutable phase visits, bounded iteration/reopen, exact reframing approval and selected-alternative evaluations. Existing cases preserved.
Criterion-linked research decisions, evidence trace and explicit next research for unmet criteria, with versioned compatibility.
Immutable proposed research agendas from unmet criteria, evidence-gap lineage, priorities, dependencies and explicit separation from action authorization.

methodology_scope: Version 3 links Deliver assessments to Define success criteria, selected-alternative evaluations and evidence; gaps identify next research. Version 2 bounded iteration and earlier cases remain supported without silent migration. Research validity still requires human judgment.
